event_venue_information:
The Fig Tree Coffee Art & Music Lounge - Roseville's Creative Music Hub

The Fig Tree Coffee Art & Music Lounge is a creative community space located at 217 Vernon Street in downtown Roseville. This unique venue blends specialty coffee artisan beverages creative baked goods and a vibrant atmosphere filled with local artwork and live music performances.

Live Music Programming

The Fig Tree features live music every Tuesday through Friday evening featuring the best local talent in the greater Sacramento region. Saturday nights host the popular Open Mic Night from 6pm to 9pm with sign-ups beginning at 5pm. The venue welcomes solo acts duos and all skill levels. The open mic list fills quickly so early arrival is encouraged. All genres including acoustic alternative rock pop and experimental music are welcome in this supportive and encouraging environment.

Creative Community Atmosphere

The space is thoughtfully designed with comfortable seating options including couches and tables. Beautiful local artwork decorates the walls and the venue maintains a bohemian artistic vibe. A free street parking lot and parking garage behind the shop provide convenient access. The community painting easel and puzzle table add to the creative energy. The atmosphere is family-friendly welcoming and supportive for musicians of all experience levels.

Amenities

Specialty coffee and espresso drinks made with Naked Coffee beans. Creative beverages including the popular Mocha Hollander and Mocha Thai. Fresh baked pastries and local baked goods. Tea selection with creative blends like Black Mango Tea and David Bowie Tea. All-ages venue with strong community focus.

title: Bluegrass Jam @ The Strum Shop
event_description: Monthly bluegrass jam session for acoustic musicians. All skill levels welcome at this family-friendly music store and community gathering space. Musicians bring instruments and jam together.
event_venue_information:
The Strum Shop - Roseville's Acoustic Music Hub

The Strum Shop is a family-owned acoustic musical instrument store located at 209 Vernon Street in downtown Roseville California. Established in May 2012 by Stu Herreid and Dan Elliott the shop specializes in ukuleles guitars banjos mandolins and dulcimers along with a variety of other curious instruments.

Community Music Programming

The Strum Shop is known for hosting a diverse array of music events throughout the month including workshops classes concerts and seminars. The venue is home to multiple music clubs and gathering groups creating a vibrant community for musicians. The Bluegrass Jam occurs on the fourth Thursday of each month welcoming all skill levels. Additional regular events include Uke University River City Ukulele Orchestra Songwriters Circle Acoustic Guitar Club Irish Slow Circle Banjo Ukulele Club Baritone Ukulele Club and River City Dulcimers.

Music Education

The Strum Shop maintains a full-time teaching staff offering private lessons daily and group lessons throughout the week. The shop takes a hands-on approach encouraging customers to grab an instrument off the wall and play. They cater to beginners and experienced musicians alike creating a welcoming environment for learning and musical expression.

Instrument Services

Full-time in-house repair technician on staff. Partnerships with outside luthiers for more extensive repairs. Instrument rentals available. New and used instruments in stock.
